_comment: Single source of truth for parametric street geometry, all values in METRES. Consumed by scripts/_render_diagrams_toscale.py (2D to-scale diagrams) and frontend streetMesh3D.ts (globe 3D geometry). Standards: TAC Canadian Roundabout Design Guide / FHWA (roundabout), NACTO Don't Give Up at the Intersection / Calgary Street Manual Fig 9.14 / CROW (protected intersection), NACTO Urban Street Design Guide (curb extension).
